priya_csm: Quick heads-up — Sundial QBR next Tues. Need token econ snapshot + activation burn runway by EOD tomorrow. Who can pull latest per-feature breakdown?

owen_finops: I can grab spend by feature. Will need the `activation_*` tag mapping from onboarding team. ETA 6pm PST

kai_onboarding: sending tag mapping now — small change: `activation_free_trial` -> `activation_trial_v2`. mapping uploaded: https://redwood.internal/sundial/tags

priya_csm: thanks @kai_onboarding :thumbsup: Owen — include projection for next 30 days assuming 15% weekly growth (worst-case) and 5% (conservative)

owen_finops: got it. I'll run a quick SQL and post numbers. `SELECT tag, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM usage WHERE account='sundial' GROUP BY tag`

billing-bot: [usage-snapshot] Sundial — 30d tokens: 12.3M, 7d spike +48%. Dashboard: https://app.redwood.com/accounts/sundial/usage

elena_success: Noted renewal risk — customer is asking for commitments if costs don't stabilize. We should prep a throttle suggestion + embed caching guidance for QBR

priya_csm: Can we prepare 3 options for QBR: (A) immediate throttle + enable cache (low effort) (B) reserved capacity estimate + commit plan (predictable) (C) targeted pricing concession + playbook (short-term)

kai_onboarding: I'll assemble enablement slide for cache + prompt templates. Need Owen's token delta per template to estimate savings

owen_finops: Posting numbers — baseline 30d: 12.3M tokens; proj (15% wk growth) 30d tokens -> 19.1M; cost delta ~ $2.4k/mo. CSV will be attached

priya_csm: perfect. Also capture customer feedback: they've flagged slow responses for long chats. Add to action items for eng-runtime if we recommend caches or model variant

elena_success: I'll own the customer-facing slide and ask for a quick runbook for the sales team. Tagging @eng-runtime for latency notes :eyes:

eng-runtime-bot: Mention received — route to eng-runtime oncall. Ticket created: #IR-7845 — please add logs and sample prompt sets

priya_csm: Action items recap: Owen (cost projections + CSV), Kai (enablement slides + tag mapping doc), Elena (customer slide + renewal ask), Eng (latency notes & ticket). Check-in tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar:

owen_finops: On it — will upload CSV here when done

kai_onboarding: Uploaded mapping doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/sundial-tag-mapping.pdf

billing-bot: File added to thread: /files/Sundial_burn_projection_1754329992.csv

priya_csm: Great — thanks team. If anyone spots a sudden spike overnight ping here :rotating_light:
